verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is a framework, so its official building surface is a set of npm packages. The evidence shows `create-docusaurus`, `@docusaurus/preset-classic`, and official plugins installed via npm, plus a pluggable architecture you extend with React components and swizzling. That is a framework-level SDK analog rather than a dedicated, documented SDK for programmatic or AI-agent integration. Missing for 10: an explicitly branded official SDK or plugin-authoring API reference, multi-language SDKs, programmatic/agent-oriented integration surfaces (the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404), and independent corroboration of building against these packages.
